parameters.frequency_per_week: Apply to every generated workout
parameters.intensity_target: Interpret null parameters as unspecified or not applicable; allocation rules constrain weekly volume rather than creating extra sessions

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Synthesis of canonical Huberman/Galpin protocols paired with explicit golf and WorkoutKit programming adaptations.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.warmup: Use an optional WorkoutStep after checking activity and goal support.
workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Check CustomWorkout.supportsActivity, supportsGoal, and supportsAlert on watchOS; store exercise selection, loads, repetitions, and technique cues in step titles/application metadata.
workoutkit_segment_mapping.recovery_block: Use supported time goals; WorkoutKit has no native repetition-count goal.
workoutkit_segment_mapping.cooldown: Provide application-guided timers when the intended modality or segment is unsupported; never silently substitute running for another activity.

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Apple's CustomWorkout documentation requires runtime capability checks for activity types, goals, and alerts before scheduling.

parameters.frequency_per_week: 2-4 sessions, totalling 150-200 minutes (aim toward 180-200 min as tolerated)
parameters.intensity_target: Zone 2 (conversational effort; nasal breathing when comfortable)

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Count walked golf rounds toward the weekly total only for minutes where heart-rate data confirms sustained Zone 2 effort; exclude cart riding, pauses, and tempo/HIIT work.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.warmup: 5-10 min easy jog, open or time goal (excluded from Zone 2 total unless heart rate qualifies)
workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Single time-goal step with a Zone 2 heart-rate alert
workoutkit_segment_mapping.cooldown: 3-5 min walk, then 3-5 min slow exhale-emphasized breathing

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Steady sub-threshold work builds mitochondrial and capillary density and supports recovery from harder sessions without adding meaningful fatigue.

parameters.intensity_target: Zone 2 continuous endurance (jog, or hike / weighted-vest walk as a substitute)

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Use run-walk intervals if needed to preserve mechanics and stay within Zone 2.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: 60-75 min time-goal step with a Zone 2 heart-rate alert

protocol_rules.source_rationale: One long continuous effort per week builds the aerobic endurance base that shorter sessions cannot.

parameters.intensity_target: 75-80% of all-out effort (Zone 3-4, steady and hard)

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Drop this session first in weeks with 2 golf rounds before dropping any resistance session.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: 30-35 min time-goal step with a heart-rate range alert at tempo effort
workoutkit_segment_mapping.cooldown: 5 min easy jog or walk, then 3-5 min slow breathing

protocol_rules.source_rationale: A sustained hard-but-submaximal effort trains cardiovascular capacity at an intensity between Zone 2 and all-out work.

parameters.frequency_per_week: 1 (mutually exclusive with vo2max_long_intervals_alternative)
parameters.intensity_target: 20-30 s all-out per round, reaching max heart rate; if running, cap stride effort near 95% to protect the hamstrings

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Do not overstride at top speed; a bike or rower is the lower-risk substitute. Doubles as the week's second (indirect) leg stimulus.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.warmup: 10 min easy jog with 2-3 short build-ups
workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Interval block, 8-12 iterations: 20-30 s time-goal work step
workoutkit_segment_mapping.recovery_block: 10 s time-goal recovery step inside each iteration
workoutkit_segment_mapping.cooldown: 5 min walk, then 3-5 min slow breathing

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Brief all-out efforts once a week drive heart rate to maximum, providing the primary stimulus for VO2 max.

parameters.frequency_per_week: 1, in place of hiit_sprint_session (never both in one week)
parameters.intensity_target: 4 min at the hardest sustainable pace (about 90-95% max HR, RPE 8-9/10), 1:1 work to rest

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Preserve consistent mechanics and repeatable pace across all 4 repetitions rather than sprinting the first rep.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Interval block, 4 iterations: 4 min time-goal work step with a high heart-rate range alert
workoutkit_segment_mapping.recovery_block: 3-4 min easy jog or walk recovery step
workoutkit_segment_mapping.cooldown: 5-10 min easy jog, then 3-5 min slow breathing

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Longer intervals at a 1:1 work-to-rest ratio hold the heart near maximum output for longer total time with lower hamstring strain than short sprints.

parameters.intensity_target: Session 1: legs (quads, hamstrings, calves). Session 2: torso push and pull plus neck. Session 3: arms, calves, neck, with dips and chin-ups for indirect torso work

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Each muscle group is trained directly once and indirectly once per week; bodyweight sessions substitute into these 3 slots rather than adding extra sessions.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.warmup: 5-10 min: light cardio plus 2-3 ramp-up sets of the first exercise
workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: One open-goal work step per set (WorkoutKit has no rep goal; exercise name and rep target live in the step title)
workoutkit_segment_mapping.recovery_block: Time-goal recovery step between sets, length set by the active schedule
workoutkit_segment_mapping.cooldown: 3-5 min slow breathing or physiological sighs

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Three sessions split by body region give every muscle one direct and one indirect stimulus per week with adequate recovery between them.

parameters.intensity_target: Heavy load; the last rep of each set is hard but clean

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: For bodyweight work, add load or pick a harder leverage variation to stay inside 4-8 reps.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.warmup: 5-10 min, including 2-3 progressively heavier warm-up sets
workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Open-goal work step per set, named with exercise and rep target
workoutkit_segment_mapping.cooldown: 3-5 min slow breathing or physiological sighs

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Heavy loads with long rests favor neural and strength adaptations because full recovery between sets keeps force output high.

parameters.intensity_target: Moderate load; sets end at or near failure with controlled technique

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Reduce load if 90-second rest prevents controlled execution.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Open-goal work step per set, named with exercise and rep target
workoutkit_segment_mapping.cooldown: 3-5 min slow breathing or physiological sighs

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Moderate loads with shorter rests raise metabolic stress and total time under tension, favoring hypertrophy.

parameters.frequency_per_week: 3 in this plan (Galpin allows 3-5), with 3-5 exercises per session
parameters.intensity_target: Strength: 85% 1RM or heavier. Power: 30-70% 1RM moved with maximum concentric speed

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Compound multi-joint lifts only. Stop each set with 1-2 clean reps left; never grind. With 3-5 min rests, 3-4 exercises is the practical limit inside the 50-60 min cap.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.warmup: 5-10 min, including 2-3 progressively heavier warm-up sets
workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Open-goal work step per set, named with exercise and rep target
workoutkit_segment_mapping.cooldown: 3-5 min slow breathing or physiological sighs

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Very low reps with full rest train the nervous system to recruit more motor units at high force or high speed without excessive muscle damage.

parameters.frequency_per_week: Switch between Schedule A and Schedule B every 4 weeks
parameters.intensity_target: Month 1 = Schedule A, Month 2 = Schedule B, repeat; galpin_3_to_5_strength_option may replace Schedule A in any heavy month

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Keep exercise selection consistent across the switch so only load, reps, and rest change.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Regenerate rep targets and set counts from the active schedule
workoutkit_segment_mapping.recovery_block: Regenerate recovery step length from the active schedule

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Alternating heavy and moderate blocks monthly keeps both strength and hypertrophy progressing and prevents plateaus.

parameters.frequency_per_week: Per muscle group: 5 hard sets to maintain, 10-15 to grow
parameters.intensity_target: 30-80% 1RM, with most sets stopping 1-2 reps short of failure

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Count direct sets fully; count indirect work (such as chin-ups for biceps or dips for chest/triceps) toward the weekly total.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Scheduler checks weekly set totals per muscle before emitting sessions

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Weekly hard-set count per muscle is the primary driver of hypertrophy, with a low floor for maintenance.

parameters.frequency_per_week: Every resistance session
parameters.intensity_target: Two exercises per directly trained muscle group

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Pair 1 movement loaded in the shortened (peak-contraction) position with 1 loaded in the lengthened (stretched) position. Examples: leg extension + squat/hack squat; leg curl + RDL; seated calf raise + standing calf raise; cable crossover + incline press; preacher curl + incline dumbbell curl.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.warmup: Ramp-up sets on the first exercise of each pair
workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Two consecutive exercise groups per muscle, each as its own interval block
workoutkit_segment_mapping.recovery_block: Recovery step per the active schedule

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Loading a muscle at both ends of its range covers the full length-tension curve for a more complete stimulus.

parameters.frequency_per_week: Every hard session
parameters.intensity_target: 5-10 min warm-up, then 50-60 min of hard work; 75 min total appointment time is the outer ceiling

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Trim lower-priority accessory sets before shortening prescribed rest intervals.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.warmup: 5-10 min, not counted against the 60 min work cap
workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Sum of work and recovery steps must not exceed 60 min
workoutkit_segment_mapping.cooldown: 3-5 min downshift, not counted against the work cap

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Hard work beyond ~60 minutes elevates cortisol and lengthens recovery without adding proportional adaptation.

parameters.frequency_per_week: Optional at the start of resistance rest intervals
parameters.intensity_target: One comfortable nasal inhale, a second smaller top-up inhale, and a prolonged unforced mouth exhale

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Perform only after safely racking/securing the load; resume normal breathing afterward.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Not an additional work step
workoutkit_segment_mapping.recovery_block: Embed cue inside the existing rest interval without shortening the rest timer

protocol_rules.source_rationale: 1-3 physiological sighs between sets rapidly down-regulate heart rate and restore focus for the next heavy set.

parameters.frequency_per_week: After every training session (mandatory; never dropped to save time)
parameters.intensity_target: Slow, exhale-emphasized breathing or repeated physiological sighs (double inhale through the nose, long exhale through the mouth)

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: After high-HR running, walk until breathing settles before starting seated/lying breathwork; stop deliberate breath manipulation if lightheaded.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Not applicable
workoutkit_segment_mapping.cooldown: 3-5 min time-goal cooldown step labelled 'Physiological Sighs Downshift'

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Long exhales stimulate the vagus nerve to slow heart rate and shift the autonomic nervous system from sympathetic drive into recovery.

parameters.intensity_target: Continuous physiological sighs at a relaxed pace

workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: 5 min time-goal step, mindAndBody or flexibility activity type

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Five minutes daily of exhale-weighted cyclic sighing lowers resting respiratory rate and improves mood and autonomic tone.

parameters.frequency_per_week: As needed, up to daily; prioritize after poor sleep or the hardest training days
parameters.intensity_target: Guided non-sleep deep rest or yoga nidra, lying still

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: NSDR does not count toward aerobic Zone 2, resistance volume, or static stretching exposure.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: 10-30 min time-goal step

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Guided non-sleep deep rest restores mental and physical energy and partly offsets sleep deficits.

parameters.frequency_per_week: 3 minimum, ~10 minutes each (5+ accumulated min/week per muscle group); 5-7 short sessions for faster range gains
parameters.intensity_target: 30 s static holds at low intensity (about 30-40% of the point of pain), never bouncing

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Stretch warm: after a workout or after 5-10 min of easy movement. Never schedule long static holds right before heavy lifting, sprinting, or full-swing golf.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Interval block per muscle group, 2-4 iterations: 30 s time-goal hold

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Range of motion gains are driven by total weekly hold time (>=5 min/muscle) distributed across frequent, low-intensity sessions.

parameters.frequency_per_week: Daily, or at minimum before each resistance and golf session
parameters.intensity_target: 10 s isometric holds per rep, descending pyramid (6, 4, 2 reps)

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Three movements only: modified curl-up, side plank (both sides), bird dog (both sides). Keep spine neutral; progress via reps, never holds longer than 10 s.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.warmup: Runs as the warm-up of a resistance or golf session, or standalone
workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Three interval blocks (one per movement), 3 iterations each, open-goal work step
workoutkit_segment_mapping.cooldown: None when used as warmup; 3-5 min downshift if standalone

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Short repeated isometric holds build proximal trunk stiffness that protects the lumbar spine and transfers force between hips and shoulders.

parameters.intensity_target: Light load, slow and controlled; flexion, extension, and lateral flexion

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Attach to the torso session and the arms session; never train to failure.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Final interval block of the host session

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Neck strength supports upright posture and stabilizes the cervical and upper thoracic spine under load.

parameters.frequency_per_week: 7-day base template: D1 long Zone 2, D2 legs, D3 recovery (heat/cold, stretching), D4 torso + neck, D5 moderate cardio, D6 HIIT/intervals, D7 arms + calves + neck
parameters.intensity_target: Any session may slide one day earlier or later to accommodate golf or life constraints

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Keep at least 48 hours between hard leg lifting and HIIT/interval running. Never place two resistance sessions for the same region on consecutive days. Do not stack two hard sessions to catch up after a missed day.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Scheduler-level rule governing day assignment

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Spacing local muscular and systemic CNS stressors allows tissue repair and glycogen restoration before reloading the same system.

parameters.frequency_per_week: 1 dedicated recovery day; weekly targets of ~11 min cold and ~57 min sauna
parameters.intensity_target: Rounds of ~20 min sauna followed by 2-5 min cold immersion

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: No cold-water immersion within 4 hours after a strength or hypertrophy lifting session.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Non-WorkoutKit recovery block; emit in app schedule metadata

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Cold immersion immediately post-lifting blunts mTOR and inflammatory signaling needed for hypertrophy and strength gains.

parameters.frequency_per_week: 1-2, placed first inside the torso session and optionally the leg session
parameters.intensity_target: Explosive intent on every rep with a light-to-moderate implement (30-70% max); stop the set if velocity drops

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Rotational medicine-ball scoop/shot-put throws, cable/band explosive chops and lifts, both sides. Perform while fresh before heavy lifting; drop one accessory lift to stay inside the 60 min cap.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.warmup: McGill Big 3 plus host session warm-up
workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: First interval block of the host session, open-goal work step per set

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Applies Galpin's power parameters (low reps, explosive intent, full rest) to maximize clubhead speed without neural fatigue.

parameters.frequency_per_week: 1-2, placed inside the torso session and optionally the leg session
parameters.intensity_target: Controlled tempo; resist rotation and build hip/trunk stability

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Anti-rotation Pallof presses, half-kneeling cable chops, single-leg RDLs, and side-plank variations. Counts against the 60 min session cap.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.warmup: McGill Big 3 plus host session warm-up
workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Interval block inside the host session, open-goal work step per set

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Uses the higher-rep hypertrophy phase to build the eccentric trunk and hip deceleration control that supports high-speed golf swings.

parameters.frequency_per_week: 3 minimum (inside static_stretching_protocol sessions); 5-7 for faster range gains
parameters.intensity_target: 30 s static holds at low intensity (30-40% of point of pain)

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Target areas: thoracic rotation, hip internal/external rotation, hip flexors, lats, and posterior shoulder (both lead and trail sides). Schedule post-round or evenings, never pre-round.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Interval block per target area, 2-4 iterations: 30 s time-goal hold

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Applies Huberman's weekly static hold threshold specifically to the thoracic, hip, and shoulder ranges that govern golf turn and sequencing.

parameters.frequency_per_week: Before every round and every full-swing range session
parameters.intensity_target: Progressive dynamic activation building from wedges to full driver speed

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: McGill Big 3 (1 set each), dynamic hip/thoracic rotations, then progressive swings from half to full speed. No static holds longer than 10 s.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Golf activity type: open-goal for rounds, or segmented 10-min skill blocks for practice
workoutkit_segment_mapping.recovery_block: None for rounds; 60-120 s between practice skill blocks
workoutkit_segment_mapping.cooldown: 3-5 min slow breathing, followed by golf_mobility_targets if desired

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Prepares spinal stiffness and rotational range dynamically without inducing the acute stretch-induced power loss caused by long static holds.

parameters.frequency_per_week: At most 2 full-swing range sessions and 1-2 rounds per week; putting/short game is unrestricted
parameters.intensity_target: Full-swing range session = hard CNS session; putting/chipping = low-strain skill; walked round = aerobic volume

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Cap full-swing range sessions at 50-60 min. Never schedule full-swing practice within 24 hours after a Schedule A torso session or on the HIIT day. In a 2-round week, drop moderate_cardio_tempo before dropping resistance sessions.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Golf activity type (or functionalStrengthTraining if watchOS restricts multi-step golf blocks)
workoutkit_segment_mapping.recovery_block: 60-120 s between 10-min skill blocks during practice
workoutkit_segment_mapping.cooldown: 3-5 min slow breathing after full-swing practice or rounds

protocol_rules.source_rationale: High-velocity driver and iron swings tax the same thoracic, hip, and central nervous system pathways as heavy torso training.

parameters.frequency_per_week: Assess before every session
parameters.intensity_target: When substantially fatigued or sleep-deprived, cut volume by ~50% or swap for NSDR/mobility; skip training when ill

protocol_rules.biomechanical_constraint: Pain or deteriorating swing/lifting mechanics overrides completion targets; after illness, ramp volume back up over 3-7 days rather than stacking missed workouts.

workoutkit_segment_mapping.work_block: Emit a reduced-volume session or replace with nsdr_session
workoutkit_segment_mapping.recovery_block: Keep full prescribed rest intervals even when cutting total sets

protocol_rules.source_rationale: Adjusting load around acute fatigue and illness prevents overtraining and injury while preserving long-term consistency.
